RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-male panel is worth questioning, but does not by itself establish that sex influenced the decision. Your qualifications are strong; the announcement alone doesn’t establish how your experience compared with his against the selection criteria.

Follow up in writing. Request the assessment criteria, your scores, reasons for the decision, and any applicable panel-composition or gender-balance rules. Frame the panel question as a concern about procedural safeguards, rather than an accusation.

Two weeks without a reply doesn’t itself indicate discrimination. Check local response requirements and complaint deadlines now; awaiting an explanation may not pause them. A union representative or equality body can advise on jurisdiction-specific protections.
